attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Grasim Industries Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of funds from its Rights Issue. The Rights Issue size was ₹3,999.80 crore. The report confirms no deviation or variation in the utilization of such funds. The proceeds were utilized for repayment of borrowings and general corporate purposes. Specifically, ₹0.70 crore was utilized for employee expenses under general corporate purposes. The unutilized balance of ₹1.04 crore was held in an Axis Bank monitoring account. The company has not observed any material deviation from the expenditures disclosed in the Offer Document. The promoter shareholding stands at 45.20 percent as on September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Grasim Industries Limited filed a presentation on Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2FY27 stood at 50,105 crore rupees, up 26% year-on-year. Standalone revenue reached an all-time high of 12,747 crore rupees, up 33% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA increased by 25% year-on-year to 6,513 crore rupees. Standalone EBITDA was 1,326 crore rupees. Adjusted profit after tax for the standalone entity was 3,132 crore rupees. The company reported total lending portfolio growth of 32% year-on-year to 2,33,930 crore rupees. Cellulosic Fibres revenue grew 29% year-on-year to 5,344 crore rupees. Cement revenue rose 19% year-on-year to 23,295 crore rupees. Chemicals revenue increased 15% year-on-year to 2,759 crore rupees.

attchmntText: Press release on the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Grasim Industries Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue reached an all-time high of Rs. 12,747 Cr., up 33% year-on-year. Standalone EBITDA was Rs. 4,615 Cr., up 158% year-on-year. Adjusted profit after tax before exceptional items stood at Rs. 3,132 Cr., up 289% year-on-year. Reported profit after tax was Rs. 2,306 Cr., up 187% year-on-year, after an exceptional charge of Rs. 825 Cr. Consolidated revenue was Rs. 50,105 Cr., up 26% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs. 6,513 Cr., up 25% year-on-year. Consolidated reported profit after tax was a loss of Rs. 234 Cr., accounting for an exceptional charge of Rs. 767 Cr. The company also disclosed a standalone dividend from UltraTech of Rs. 3,968 Cr.

attchmntText: Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Grasim Industries Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board also approved an investment proposal up to C$ 91.8 million, approximately INR 625 Crore, in the proposed Rights Issue of AV Group NB Inc, a joint venture. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was INR 12,746.50 crore, with a net profit of INR 2,306.16 crore. For the six-month period, revenue from operations stood at INR 24,541.21 crore, and net profit was INR 2,552.81 crore. The results include an exceptional item charge of INR 825.43 crore related to AVNB. The meeting commenced at 12.30 p.m. and concluded at 02:10 p.m. on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Intimation of schedule of Analysts / Institutional Investor Meet
voiceSummary: Grasim Industries Limited has intimated the schedule for investor meetings on 18th November 2026. The company will hold one-on-one and group meetings with CITIC CLSA during the 29th India Forum 2026. These interactions will take place in Mumbai. The meetings will be conducted in physical mode. Investor presentations will be available on the company website. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. The schedule is subject to change.
